description: This file contains a static helper class 'DatabaseUrlParser' that provides functionality to parse PostgreSQL database URLs (in URI form) into an Npgsql connection string. It includes methods for validating and extracting user info, database name, and query parameters like SSL mode, to facilitate database connections.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: A static helper class for converting PostgreSQL URLs into Npgsql connection strings.

methods.name: ToNpgsqlConnectionString
methods.description: Converts a PostgreSQL URL into an Npgsql connection string, validating the URL and extracting necessary parameters.

methods.name: ParseUserInfo
methods.description: Parses user info segment of the URI to extract username and password.

methods.name: ApplyQueryParameters
methods.description: Applies URL query parameters such as sslmode and trust_server_certificate to the Npgsql connection string builder.
